patterns: Price before the block: on 8 of 8 sales calls, fewer than 5 beats landed before the first number (0 beats on 4 calls, 1 on 2, 2 on 1, 3 on 1). The default opener is still "So there are two ways that you could go about. One is a quick fix" (Julie Rhymes, Gayle Martin, Jay Schiering, John Litchfield). When the beats do come, they come after the price (Litchfield: 70% body weight, net, new soil, all delivered after TMCP was chosen).

TMCP never led with a recommendation on new leads: 0 of 7 new-lead calls. Only returning customer Lan, who asked about the annual plan, got "That is actually a best plan." Three times he accepted "we just want to do the one time" with no one-month reply (Jay Schiering: "Sure. Okay. Please give me your first and last name."). He offered both quotes once (John Kim: "Do you want me to send you both of the codes"), and both were sent on Archie Heacox.

Guarantee and quote hygiene are solid: guarantee said on 7 of 7 QF quotes ("if we're not able to catch any moles, then we wouldn't charge you anything other than the setup fee"). Every promised quote was in Jobber within 1-10 minutes with the correct line item, deposit (QF $150 / TMCP $0), address and salesperson. One miss: Sam Pulu got "Yes, sir" to "any guarantee you're going to catch them all?".

Out-of-area handling is improvised: 4 calls (Rainier, Bainbridge, Poulsbo, Rochester). Each got "we are working on it... I'll reach out to the team" instead of the Kitsap referral to Terry Cotton or the sheet's confirm-and-call-back-today rule. One of the four (Rainier) was actually served and converted at $1,800.

Existing-customer calls get no timeframe and the system takes the blame: on 5 call-outs he said "as soon as possible" or "as soon as we can" with no day (Champion x2, Christina Long, Sprague, Chapman), and he twice blamed the routing software ("It's because of that routing software that we just got"). Champion escalated across three days. Capture remains a strength (6 of 8 sales calls with full capture and address read-back) and tone held at 14-15.
